title: RETSCH
content: RETSCH is a German laboratory milling and sample-preparation specialist supplying ball mills and related equipment for reducing hard, brittle, and fibrous materials. These systems are relevant to aerogel precursor solids processing, powder preparation, and upstream materials workflow support. RETSCH is an appropriate Equipment Materials listing for laboratories that need robust preparation tools ahead of characterization and formulation work.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
